releaseTitle: Shift4 Dine POS Foundation and Reliable Schedule PDF Printing
notes: Adds a secure, manual, read-only Shift4 Dine Marketplace data bridge with server-only OAuth credentials.
Normalizes allowlisted ticket and item data into idempotent review records with cent-based money fields and safe CSV/JSON exports.
Replaces the active Month Schedule browser-print action with lazy pdf-lib Letter-landscape PDF output and a download fallback.
Adds a dedicated new-implementation regression suite covering Shift4 security, failures, idempotency, exports, and schedule PDF behavior.
title: 86 Chaos 16.0.234
summary: Secure read-only Shift4 Dine imports, stable Month Schedule PDF printing, and a dedicated regression suite.
